6.10.rationale: The Indonesian regulation explicitly includes refugees/displacement for children: Pasal 39 ayat (1) huruf a lists “Anak yang menjadi pengungsi” as a group receiving “Pelindungan Khusus” in emergency situations, with detailed measures in Pasal 39 ayat (3) (evacuation, security, basic needs, legal aid, reunification, etc.). Thus the policy does contain targeted protection for refugees (at least child refugees). The judge’s Yes matches the Indonesian text; the golden label ‘No’ is likely wrong.
